claims.claim: A uniform polynomial classical estimator for the unrestricted interface would imply BQP=BPP.
claims.limit: Conditional complexity barrier, not an unconditional classical lower bound.

claims.claim: A history combination with m zero product-boundary jets admits the explicit local short-horizon tail bound A3.
claims.limit: The positive local majorant requires g*abs(tau)<1; history support and variation Gamma are charged.

claims.claim: The jet-null remainder has an explicit unbiased nested-commutator estimator with absolute sample envelope W_m and variance at most W_m squared.
claims.limit: Mathematical unbiasedness uses the full order distribution. The finite implementation records its order-tail bias. No long-time polynomial variation or certificate acquisition bound is established.

claims.claim: Orthogonal first-return elimination yields a positive matrix spectral kernel and a conservative finite phase register with moment matching and horizon-dependent error.
claims.limit: Not a novelty claim. Krylov vector acquisition can remain exponential, and a nonorthogonal product-reset projection does not inherit the positive-measure proof.

claims.claim: Every target signal on a polynomial horizon has a polynomial-size conservative phase approximation.
claims.limit: Acquisition is not efficient in general. Hilbert-Schmidt readout conditioning is retained. This is not a simulator or a complexity advantage.

claims.claim: A bounded nearest-neighbor autonomous chain has an exponentially quiet local window followed by an order-one revival.
claims.limit: The engineered-chain model is established and exactly solvable. It disproves a deletion inference, not efficient simulation of every easy model.

claims.claim: The same chain generates maximal half-chain volume-law entanglement from a Neel product input while local occupations are acquired polynomially.
claims.limit: Known quadratic closure, not an interacting-system breakthrough or an advantage over free-fermion methods.

claims.claim: Finite endpoint return moments can agree exactly while later return amplitudes differ by order one.
claims.limit: The exact moment identity is proved; the reported maximum amplitude discrepancy is sampled on a finite time grid.

claims.claim: The boundary-jet packing and return-phase combination gives a new polynomial classical simulator for a consequential interacting lattice class.
claims.limit: Requires an explicit interacting class and acquisition-inclusive certificate/variation theorem. Novelty of the combination is also unresolved.

remaining_gates: Prove G1 from an explicit physically meaningful interacting Hamiltonian promise, rather than from supplied compressed data.
Retain slow conserved modes, return phases, product-state conditioning and delayed-echo controls.
Compare against matched short-time cluster, sparse Pauli, observable-subspace, influence-functional and operator-backflow baselines.
Establish any novelty before making an invention or priority claim.
